pages.title: Let's Plow
pages.text: Denver is the shortest race in Skitchin', just 4.5 miles, and Let's Plow is its song. The game warns you that Denver drivers don't keep to one side of the road, so watch your rear-view mirror. The password for the race is BRONCOS.

pages.title: Almost Road Rash III
pages.text: Early in 1994, a reader asked the British magazine Mean Machines Sega when "Road Rash III: Roller Rash" would come out. The magazine replied that the game was called Skitchin and was due in March. The reader wasn't far off, since Skitchin' runs on the Road Rash II engine.

pages.title: The host rates each course
pages.text: Before each race, the game's TV host tells you how tough the course will be. His ratings run from "a cake walk" and "easy, even for Handbags" up to "a donor skate" and "the pinnacle of pain."
